  (s : Finset α) (hs : s.card ≤ n) : p s :=
match s with
| .empty => H ∅ (fun h _ => absurd h (by omega)) hs

    | .empty => absurd ht (by omega)

      have : t'.subset_insert x t := by simp
      ih' this (by assumption))
